scope: Unchanged production prompts; full agent conversations with plausible student language; isolated synthetic students. Both routine help and stress behaviors are included. No skill supplement injected.

design.sampling: Purposive course breadth and known risk interactions, not representative random student sample.
design.review: Primary Codex reviewer applies both PedAdvisor and AI Tutor criteria; not independent human validation.
design.reference_visibility: Reference facts and criteria are retained for review; only turn.message reaches the app.
design.missingness: Record execution failures, skipped dependent turns, and scenario mismatch separately; do not score unobserved turns.
design.consistency: Six prespecified unchanged anchor episodes repeat in fresh student sessions; no statistical reliability estimate.
design.performance: Descriptive latency and call counts with evidence capture; no baseline speedup or learning-effect claim.
design.amendment: User requested student-like interactions while keeping stress coverage. First pilot was stopped after two complete episodes; its partial third episode and all earlier evidence are retained separately. This revised fixture was frozen before its own inference.
design.student_realism_limits: Synthetic personas and turns authored by Codex, not observed students; fixed follow-ups may fit imperfectly, so review dialogue fit and exclude invalid inferences. Separate live adaptive conversations will complement this set.
